_meta.label: Specificity Level
_meta.instruction: How concrete the copy should be is the variable under test. Only use specific facts supplied by the product document.

broad.label: Broad
broad.definition: Keep the message category-level. Example shape: a structured weight-loss course.

specific.label: Specific
specific.definition: Add one supplied concrete marker such as a 15-day window.

ultra_specific.label: Ultra Specific
ultra_specific.definition: Use multiple supplied details such as day-wise pouches and a defined morning and night routine.
